editorial:
Ever wondered what it would be like to have a robot for a best friend? You get to experience that exactly in this sweet story about a teen who finds himself in the middle of a high-stakes rescue mission. When a friendly bot named A.R.I. gets snatched by a mean lab director, it is up to our brave young hero to step up and save him. The vibe is very much like those classic Saturday morning cartoons where a kid takes on a giant evil company to do what is right. It feels lighthearted and sincere, making it a great choice for a cozy movie night with the family.

You will probably love how the bond between the boy and the robot grows, though the pacing can feel a bit slow in some spots. The acting is natural, and the action scenes are exciting enough to keep you interested. While the special effects are not Hollywood-level, they still look great enough to believe in the world. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a smart move for a rainy day.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the teen manages to sneak into the corporate headquarters to rescue A.R.I. just before the villain can turn him into a weapon. After a big showdown, the evil director is defeated and his plan to rule the world fails. A.R.I. chooses friendship over power and decides to stay with his human pal. They end up safe and happy, proving that love is stronger than any piece of cold machinery.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and robots.
